assumptions.assumed_value: Strict mode requested: engines must generate real EG/FG grid-based surfaces, nonzero cut/fill volumes, and surface-derived low points; fail the job if any engine cannot produce these.
Hydraulic storm sizing and capacity checks required; trunk and laterals sized to convey to southern detention ponds without surcharge under design storm; if impossible, fail.
ADA compliance required for roads/parking/sidewalks (max 2% cross slope on walks/accessible stalls, longitudinal slopes within code); if grading engine cannot validate, fail.
Water system to be looped with coordinated crossings and no utility conflicts; sanitary to avoid conflicts and maintain cover/slope; if conflict check fails, fail.
Quantities (building area, parking count, pipe length, utility length, impervious area) must be sourced from the generated model; placeholder values not accepted; if extraction fails, fail.
Assumed primary access/frontage on north edge; 4% uniform south slope assumed for EG across site for initial layout.
Outfalls and utility tie-ins assumed available along southern boundary; final connection points to be verified by utility model.
Expanded multi-object layout path used.
Geometry is concept-level and intended for planning and DXF generation.
Parking geometry upgraded with aisle/stall logic when possible.
Planner executed model-first workflow with ProjectManager as active lifecycle state.
Action geometry is treated as output packaging, not the primary internal truth.
Drainage stage used user-supplied drainage geometry directly and skipped synthetic fallback generation.
Utility stage used user-supplied utility geometry directly and skipped fallback routing.
